RFD4 active sites: both candidate proton-acceptor routes

Eight distinct structures are represented by 37 repeated files. Purple marks the contact from MVAP C3 hydroxyl oxygen to the nearest Asp carboxylate oxygen. Orange marks its contact to the nearest nonbridging ATP gamma-phosphate oxygen. All three ATP gamma-oxygen distances are reported below.

These are heavy-atom distances, not mechanism probabilities. No hydroxyl hydrogen, validated protonation/solvation model, or matched activation barriers are available for the designs. The nearby Asp and Lys atoms carry source coordinate-conditioning annotations. The full catalytic network needs separate validation.
